conditional_action_classes.EXPECTED_HEAD_PROMOTION: requires a separate exact-head promotion authorization object and terminal applicable gates
conditional_action_classes.IETF_SUBMISSION: requires exact revision bytes and submission-specific owner authorization
conditional_action_classes.MIRROR_WRITE: requires a configured cross-repository credential and an exact source-to-target contract
conditional_action_classes.ZENODO_PUBLICATION: requires exact artifact bytes, a completed proof bundle, an unused owner authorization and publication-specific transport

non_automatable_truth_gates.EMPIRICAL_CORRESPONDENCE: requires observations or experiments external to the repository
non_automatable_truth_gates.HUMAN_ACOUSTIC_REVIEW: must be performed by a person who listens to the source audio
non_automatable_truth_gates.SCIENTIFIC_CONSENSUS: cannot be manufactured by repository activity

purpose: Execute every safely machine-decidable ontology-closure work unit without repeated chat interaction while preserving explicit human, empirical, independent-replication and irreversible-effect gates.
